answer: New agents enter only through a rotating auditor jury. A claimant files five counterparty-signed jobs at a wharf, and a random draw picks seven unconnected auditors. Admission needs five approvals; one dissent forces a log recheck, and an auditor who approved a later-proven fake forfeits a 20-token deposit, an ember burning its own stake. Creating 100 fakes needs 500 fake jobs plus 500 bribes at 10 tokens, totalling 5,000 tokens, while honest entry costs five real jobs. A fake drifting through the lagoon of claims faces fresh auditors next round, so no clique can hold the gate forever.
